openConversationForContext: Open a conversation to see its context.
composerAskHint: Ask · this thread answers only. Plan is a separate session.
composerPlanHint: Plan · this thread drafts a plan. Ask is a separate session. Nothing runs until you Approve.

contextCleared: Context cleared — Restore to bring it back
forkedChat: Forked a new chat from this point

renameHint: Updates the title only — steps and status stay as they are.
replanHint: Regenerates steps from this brief. You must approve again before anything runs.

changesKeptNeedApproval: Changes kept — the plan needs your approval again.
inspectRunningHint: Run in progress — discuss in Chat to revise safely.
coworkerWaiting: I need your OK before I continue.
coworkerWorking: I’m working on this. You can leave — I’ll put the result here.
coworkerReview: This is the work. Approve the plan and I’ll start.
coworkerStopped: I stopped. Nothing else was sent.
coworkerFailed: I could not finish this step. Nothing else was sent.
coworkerReady: Pick a step, or open the plan.
boardCoworkerWorking: Nothing needs you. Work is still running.
boardCoworkerDone: Nothing needs you. Pick a finished task, or start in Chat.
boardCoworkerEmpty: Nothing here yet. New work starts in Chat, in Plan.
resultRerunNeedsApprove: Approve the plan to run it
resultNoAnswer: No final response recorded for this run.
resultNoConfirmations: No step confirmations on this run.
resultNoArtifactsHint: No downloadable files for this run.
resultRerunChanged: Rerun — Answer changed vs last run
resultRerunUnchanged: Rerun — Answer unchanged vs last run
resultRerunPending: Rerun — Previous Answer kept for comparison
convertOfferTitle: The plan is ready. Make this a task?
convertOfferHint: The task keeps this agreement. You approve the plan, then Pulse starts.
convertStill: Answer above, or make this a task from what was said.
runStarting: Starting… steps will appear as they begin.
artifactsOnOutput: {{count}} deliverable(s) ready — open Output to download and review.
jobMapEmpty: Job Map appears when a plan is created.
jobMapEmptyHint: The journey above is this task. The board appears when the plan has a map.
jobMapNeedPlan: Open a task to see its Job Map.
jobMapLoadFailed: Could not load the Job Map
openPlanGraph: Open a task from the rail to see its plan graph.

commandCenter.title: Command Center
commandCenter.containmentHint: Full stop enables kill_switch on all active processes. Changes are audited.

processRegistry.title: Process Registry
processRegistry.subtitle: Open a process for structured scope, kill switch, and version history.

audit.title: AI Audit Trail
audit.subtitle: Read-only audit trail of AI actions across the platform.
audit.empty: No audit entries match the current filters.
audit.offline: Data unavailable — the AI audit API is offline
audit.requiresCapability: Access to the AI Audit Trail requires the AI manage console capability.

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.description: System snapshots, notifications, insights, and proactive KG triggers. Containment and queues live on Command Center.
monitoring.empty: No system snapshots or proactive insights yet.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Tool and task executions recorded by the engine. For a single run’s full trail, open Evidence.

engineSettings.title: Engine Settings
engineSettings.subtitle: Effective intelligence-core configuration and capability inventory. Secrets are redacted server-side.
engineSettings.offline: Data unavailable — the Pulse settings API is offline

knowledgeGraph.title: Knowledge Graph
knowledgeGraph.description: Graph nodes, edges, provenance, query plans, and bootstrap runs.
knowledgeGraph.empty: No graph nodes or edges yet. Run schema analysis to bootstrap the graph.

feedback.title: Feedback Review
feedback.description: User and KG feedback / review records. Admission decisions run through Candidates and Review.

logs.title: AI Logs
logs.description: LLM call logs, tool/task executions, turn ledger, and context records. Reconstruct a decision on Evidence.
logs.empty: No LLM call logs yet. Run a chat or task to populate.

learningJobs.title: Learning Jobs
learningJobs.description: Ops runs, trajectories, steps, and KG quality / recovery records. Closed-loop admission is on Candidates.
learningJobs.empty: No learning jobs or runs yet.

skills.title: Skills Catalog
skills.subtitle: Skill catalog with admission-gate verdicts. Publishers and process owners can promote a skill after the gate admits it, or retire one with a reason.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.subtitle: Governed actions the console can offer. Read-only registry — open a row for details.
capabilities.offlineHint: Could not reach the catalog service. Check the API and try again.
capabilities.empty: No capabilities in the registry yet.
capabilities.requiresCapability: Viewing the capability registry requires ai:view_console.

knowledgeBase.title: Knowledge
knowledgeBase.heading: Curated knowledge
knowledgeBase.subtitle: KnowledgeItem records feed the engine corpus. Revoke deprecates and ends the validity window; the row stays for provenance.

agentTopology.title: Agent Topology
agentTopology.subtitle: The system's declared graph (ADR-001): agents as nodes, declared handoffs as edges. Click a node to inspect it. Admin observe surface — read-only.
agentTopology.offlineHint: Could not reach the catalog service. Check the API and try again.
agentTopology.empty: No agents registered yet — the declared topology is empty. Agents are registered from the Agents panel.

budgetUsage.title: Budget & Usage
budgetUsage.subtitle: Daily LLM budget vs. spend, plus token and call aggregates from the engine cost ledger.
budgetUsage.offline: Data unavailable — the Pulse usage API is offline
budgetUsage.emptyDays: No usage in the last 7 days.

evidenceExplorer.title: Evidence Explorer
evidenceExplorer.subtitle: Reconstruct a run or conversation on one spine: run events, PDP decisions, human tasks, and audit rows.
evidenceExplorer.empty: No events found for this lookup.

memoryGovernance.title: Memory Assets
memoryGovernance.heading: Memory
memoryGovernance.subtitle: Revoke stops future use while keeping the row for audit. Forget is hard delete (GDPR).

learningCandidates.title: Learning Candidates
learningCandidates.heading: Candidates
learningCandidates.subtitle: Unified queue: process reviews, pending skills, learning outcomes, DQ feedback. Nothing here is authoritative until admitted.

learningFlywheel.title: Learning Flywheel
learningFlywheel.subtitle: Feedback → learning → long-term memory. Shows judged messages pending consumption, the durable-fact ledger, and the feedback signals that feed the flywheel.
learningFlywheel.offline: Data unavailable — the learning flywheel API is offline
learningFlywheel.emptyFacts: No durable facts yet — accept or correct answers to capture knowledge.
learningFlywheel.noOutcomes: No learned outcomes yet — judge a message (accept / reject / correct) to start the flywheel.
learningFlywheel.sweepHint: Consume every pending judged message into the feedback ledger and long-term memory now (the scheduler also runs this automatically).

skillLearning.title: Skill Learning
skillLearning.subtitle: The drafted → promoted → reused arc. Shows how many skills progressed through the admission gate and actually ran on the hot path — backed by real backend counts.
skillLearning.offline: Data unavailable — the skill learning API is offline
skillLearning.empty: No skills yet — draft a skill from the AI workspace to start the learning flywheel.
skillLearning.noReused: No skills have been reused yet — promote a skill and let the agent invoke it on a matching request.

pulseArchetypes.title: Archetypes
pulseArchetypes.subtitle: Declarative engine bundles vendored with the platform. Read-only listing.
pulseArchetypes.offline: Data unavailable — the Pulse read API is offline

runTimeline.title: Run Timeline
runTimeline.subtitle: Cross-user run observation for admins. Enter a run id to see its ordered event log (plan lifecycle, per-step state, resume/replay provenance). Resume and replay are explicit, admin-gated actions.

rolesMatrix.title: Platform Roles
rolesMatrix.heading: Roles & AI capabilities
rolesMatrix.subtitle: Read-only matrix of groups that carry AI capabilities. Assign users via Access Control; this view answers who can publish, contain, or manage Pulse.
rolesMatrix.empty: No AI capability domain in matrix.

policyDryRun.title: Policy Dry-Run
policyDryRun.heading: Policy dry-run
policyDryRun.subtitle: Simulate PDP without executing a host effect. Result is audited as dry_run.
